resources.string: Break the loop. Keep the connection.
Evaluates feasibility of identifying Instagram\'s dedicated Reels tab using sanitized structural layout signals. Does not read or store private messages, passwords, or personal content.

OutLoop investigates whether Instagram\'s dedicated Reels tab can be reliably distinguished from DMs, Stories, profiles, and the ordinary home feed using native accessibility structure alone. This prototype only performs detection and does not block or modify Instagram.

OutLoop requires Android's Accessibility Service to observe window structure in Instagram.

• What it inspects: Sanitized layout containers, tab bars, and widget types.
• What it NEVER reads: Private message text, usernames, passwords, or personal details.
• Zero Network Access: OutLoop requests NO internet permission; all analysis stays 100% on this device.
• No Blocking: This prototype only tests detection accuracy.
• Diagnostic Control: Inspection only occurs while a diagnostic session is explicitly running.

You can disable this permission at any time in Android Accessibility Settings.
